newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia to launch 26 new industrial zones.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia to launch 26 new industrial zones.

text.p: The Tunisian government on Friday said it would launch 26 new industrial zones around the country in conjunction with the private sector.
The decision was made at a cabinet meeting chaired by Tunisian President Zine al-abidine Ben Ali, officials said.
Since 1973, the government has established 43 industrial zones, mainly around the coastal cities, permitting the settling there of some 3,500 firms.
The private sector will be allowed -- for the first time -- to be involved in the setting up of the new zones, officials said.
